picks.name: Children's Museum of Manhattan (CMOM), 212 West 83rd Street
picks.when: 10 am-5 pm, Tuesday-Sunday on their plan-your-visit page. Their FAQ lists Monday-Sunday for July-September, so check before going on a Monday.

picks.name: Central Park Zoo with the Tisch Children's Zoo, East 64th Street and 5th Avenue
picks.age_fit: admission includes the Tisch Children's Zoo
picks.when: Opens 10 am daily. April-October it closes at 5 pm Monday-Friday and 5:30 pm on weekends. Last entry is 1 hour before closing.

picks.name: Bronx Zoo, Children's Zoo, 2300 Southern Blvd, Bronx
picks.age_fit: Children's Zoo is included in Bronx Zoo admission
picks.when: Opens 10 am. April 2-October 31, 2026 hours: closes 5 pm Monday-Friday and 5:30 pm on weekends. Children's Zoo is seasonal and weather permitting.
